content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-199. - I.R.C. Section 2-N1101.12, Maintenance information.
content.summary:
Section N1101.12. Maintenance information,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
N1101.12. Maintenance information.
Maintenance instructions shall be furnished for equipment and systems that require
                  preventive maintenance."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
